title: Coworker: man 31 breathing fast, tingling in both hands and lips, sure he's dying, has had panic attacks

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pier 17, the Harbor Co-working space, second floor. My coworker can't catch his breath.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He's breathing super fast, like gasping, and he says both his hands are tingling and his lips feel buzzy. He keeps saying he's dying.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, he's talking a mile a minute, he's sweating and shaking. He's 31, he's normally really healthy.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Has anything like this happened to him before?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He told me he gets panic attacks, he had a bad one last year before a presentation. He has a big pitch in ten minutes.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Can he move both arms and speak clearly?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yeah, both arms are fine, he's gripping the chair with both hands, and he's speaking clearly, just fast.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Have him sit and try to slow his breathing with you.
